item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.19
item.description: - Tables keep sensible column widths, so words no longer break inside cells (Google Docs). - Right-click the icon to turn ConformTXT off or on, or to open Settings. - Clearer shortcut choices: "⌘V (every paste)" or "⌥⇧⌘V (⌘V stays normal)". - History says "Nothing yet." before your first paste.
